clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau spent eight and a half years in prison for contempt of court - never charged with a crime. While he was there, he taught other inmates how to control their minds instead of reacting to everything around them.

One of those men was a drug dealer. He got out, cleaned up, and built an online business. Today he makes a million dollars a month.

His own words: it made him feel like Superman - in control of his life instead of controlled by it.

What would you build if nothing could trigger you?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfdiscipline #successstory #emotionalcontrol #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people's brains broadcast on a different wave - right between alpha and theta. He calls it the billionaire brainwave. Stay in beta too long, he says, and you're stuck broadcasting the poverty wave instead.

Here's the part most people miss: wanting more money isn't enough if something invisible keeps pushing back. A headwind. A thousand pounds on your back for no reason you can name.

Kevin calls that counter intention - and until you clear it, the wanting alone won't move you anywhere.

Have you ever felt that invisible resistance?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #lawofattraction #wealthmindset #subconsciousmind #mindset

You land the deal. Then you get drunk the night before, show up late, and blow it. Why would you do that?

Kevin Trudeau calls it a counter intention - a subconscious program working against the very thing you say you want. It shows up with money too: want more, but your grandmother taught you money is the root of all evil, and now every dollar you make fights an invisible headwind.

You didn't do it on purpose. That's the problem - you did it without knowing.

What program might be running underneath what you want?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfsabotage #subconsciousmind #moneymindset #success
